CustomField.inlineHelpText: JSON blob of client-only environmental signals (timezone, screen resolution, browser language, platform) collected via JavaScript alongside the reCAPTCHA v3 token, since these signals are not available to Apex/Visualforce server-side. Blank for events where no client JS hook was present (e.g. some submission paths). See docs/fraud-monitoring-recaptcha-ip-geo.md.
CustomField.label: Client Env JSON
